name: 调色实验室
description: 从一个种子色生长出配色方案 - 和谐色调、感知均匀的 OKLab 渐变以及 WCAG/APCA 可读性标识,支持 DTCG 令牌和 CSV 导出。
inputs.seed.label: 种子颜色
inputs.seed.help: 整个色板由此颜色衍生而来 - 默认使用你的品牌主色。
inputs.harmony.label: 和谐
inputs.harmony.help: 强调色色相如何围绕种子色旋转。
inputs.steps.label: 渐变步数
inputs.steps.help: 每个色阶渐变中的色调数量，从深到浅。
inputs.neutrals.label: 包含中性色
inputs.neutrals.help: 为文本和表面添加带种子色调的灰阶渐变。
inputs.mode.label: Ramp mode
inputs.mode.help: Perceptual grows each ramp as even OKLab tones. Contrast solves every step to a target APCA readability level against the background.
inputs.bg.label: Background
inputs.bg.help: The surface the palette sits on. In Contrast mode every step is solved for readability against it - defaults to your brand surface (white in a neutral brand).
inputs.contrastCurve.label: Contrast curve
inputs.contrastCurve.help: How the target APCA Lc is spread across the ramp in Contrast mode.
inputs.lcTargets.label: Custom Lc targets
inputs.lcTargets.help: Optional comma list of APCA Lc targets, one per step (e.g. 15,30,45,60,75,90). Overrides the curve when set.
inputs.cssStyle.label: CSS export style
inputs.cssStyle.help: How the CSS download is shaped. Variables emit :root custom properties; Classes emit bg/text/border utility classes. Only affects the CSS export.
